title: Rerating.
bodyText: No person, business, or entity may change or rerate any rate approved by the commissioner in any subsequent transfer, sale, resale, or pass through of health insurance issued by a managed care plan.
bodyHtml: [§431:14G-103.5]  Rerating.  No person, business, or entity may change or rerate any rate approved by the commissioner in any subsequent transfer, sale, resale, or pass through of health insurance issued by a managed care plan. [L 2015, c 63, §22]
